title: allow the ui role to run go run ./cmd/ork with --help so CLI help can be rendered for the approval card

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-120855-7418, project ork, item S405:

allow the ui role to run go run ./cmd/ork with --help so CLI help can be rendered for the approval card

Evidence: go -C WORKTREE run ./cmd/ork tracking commit --help was denied with no approval surface, so no render was possible
